purpose: test whether candidate adds GPU/UCF read traffic; mechanism observation, not performance acceptance
validity: shared lease entire stage with monitoring
all counter snapshots complete and enabled==running
pre-request count and first-output-to-stop each in [0,1000000] ns
primary_gate: Both paired B-A read-byte counts exceed max(R_bytes, 1GiB), where R_bytes is max within-variant absolute repeat difference. This permits targeted follow-up, not causality or acceptance.
secondary: report raw cycles, request count, outstanding; no stall/latency conversion or post-hoc gate
failure_action: stop on validity failure; preserve outputs; do not rerun successful requests. After four requests stop family regardless of direction. No sampling until favorable timing.
limits: HTTP first-output window can include early decode and system-wide background; changed byte counts alone do not prove causal TTFT contribution
